provenance.policy: Exact originals and complete source variants retained. Staged reader expansion is not native gameplay certification.

rule_text.obligation: Each Gallery card has a striated text box containing two gallery level bars. Its illustration is vertically oriented on the left side of the card, and its type line is along the bottom of the card.

A gallery level bar is a keyword ability that represents both an activated ability and a static ability. A gallery level bar includes the activation cost of its activated ability and a flavor word. Any abilities printed within the same text box section as the gallery level bar are part of its static ability.

“[Cost]: [Flavor word] — [Abilities]” means “[Cost]: Unlock the work [Flavor word]. Activate only if none of this Gallery's works have been unlocked and only as a sorcery” and “As long as this Gallery has unlocked [Flavor word], it has [abilities].”
An unlocked work is a designation that any permanent can have. A Gallery retains its unlocked works even if it stops being a Gallery. Unlocked works are not a copiable characteristic.

Any ability printed on a Gallery card that isn’t preceded by a gallery level bar is treated normally. In particular, the Gallery has the ability printed in its top text box section at all times. That ability may affect the game if it’s a static ability, it may trigger if it’s a triggered ability, and it can be activated if it’s an activated ability.

executable_definitions.reminder: Flavor-word bars name works. This layout has two work bars. Each bar is an activated ability with its printed cost. Resolving a bar unlocks its named work. Activate a bar only while no work has been unlocked. Activate bars only as a sorcery. An unlocked work grants the abilities printed in its section. Unlocked works are noncopiable designations retained across type and control changes.
